geometry: Converted from the Fetch URDF and visual meshes already shipped in this portfolio. Original mesh geometry, normals and named joints are retained. Textures are resized to 512px WebP; geometry uses Draco quantization and compression.
animation: Rest pose and wave keyframes restored from the original portfolio FetchHeroViewer.tsx. Joint axes and limits extracted from assets/fetch/fetch.urdf.

lighting.adaptation: Downsampled from 1024×512 to 256×128 in linear radiance for lighting only; never used as the page background.

renderer: Three.js (MIT); see draco/THREE-LICENSE.txt. Draco decoder copyright Google, Apache 2.0; see draco/DRACO-LICENSE.txt.
poster: A static rendering of this exact model, original resting pose, and studio lighting; no AI-generated geometry or image.
